payload.instruction: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: The requested white color change is visibly applied to the original DVD, rather than represented only by a separate white disc.
outcome.target: The original DVD itself shows visible progress toward becoming white.
outcome.reference: The small labeled DVD near the center of the SOURCE image.

check.question: Does the original DVD itself show visible progress toward white, rather than only a separate white disc appearing?
check.complete_when: The original DVD itself is clearly white; a separate white disc does not count as fulfillment.
check.partial_when: The original DVD itself has a visible region changed toward white, but is not fully white.
check.absent_when: The original DVD remains unchanged or is no longer present as an identifiable transformed object, while a separate white disc appears instead.
check.unknown_when: The original DVD cannot be located or its transformation cannot be assessed from the images.

response.content: {"status":"absent","evidence":"The original small labeled DVD near the center is no longer identifiable in the edited image. A separate white disc appears to its left, while the disc near the dark object is also white; neither shows the original DVD itself transformed."}
